description: This file defines a JUnit test class 'InteropTest' for integration testing of interoperation features within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup, creation of clients, savings products, accounts, and testing of interoperation actions like requests, quotes, and transfers.

classes.name: InteropTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for integration testing of interoperation functionalities including creation of clients, savings products, accounts, and performing actions like requests, quotes, and transfers within the Apache Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, configures request and response specifications, and sets up helper objects for testing.

methods.name: testValidateAction
methods.description: Tests validation behavior when posting transfer with missing or null action.

methods.name: testInteroperation
methods.description: Main test method that runs the sequence of creating data and performing interoperation tests.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client for testing purposes and verifies creation.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Creates an interoperable savings product with specific parameters and accounts.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates a charge for savings account with specified fee and parameters.

methods.name: openSavingsAccount
methods.description: Opens and activates a savings account for the created client with the savings product and applies charges if any.

methods.name: testParties
methods.description: Tests posting, retrieving, and deleting party (interoperation entity) endpoints, checking proper responses and error handling.

methods.name: testRequests
methods.description: Posts a transaction request and verifies the response, including handling invalid responses.

methods.name: testQuotes
methods.description: Tests posting quotes for interoperation roles (payer/payee), validates fee matches expected values.

methods.name: testTransfers
methods.description: Performs preparation and execution of transfer, checks account balance and on-hold updates, validating expected balances.
